# proxmox_qemu_rrddata (Data Source)

Reads raw RRD metric points of a QEMU VM from `GET /nodes/{node}/qemu/{vmid}/rrddata` and returns them as a JSON array.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_qemu_rrddata" "cpu" {
  node      = "pve-1"
  vmid      = 300
  timeframe = "day"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) Cluster node.
- `timeframe` (String) `hour`, `day`, `week`, `month`, `year` or `decade`.
- `vmid` (Number) QEMU VM ID.

### Read-Only

- `data` (String) JSON array of metric points.
